transcript: Yesterday, my boyfriend Paul and I went to see Primafacie on Broadway, starring Jodiecomer. This is a solo show about a woman named Tessa who is a defense attorney. She often works sexual assault cases. But when she herself becomes a victim of sexual assault, she sees from a new point of view the legal system and its pitfalls. This play condemns how the system doesn't adequately capture the experiences of victims and in many ways is built to protect abusers. It is intense and devastating, but riveting and so, so memorable. Jodie Comer is performing at 110% for 100 minutes straight, and it's mind boggling that she does this 8x1 week. As an aside, with this show, I've now seen every show of the twenty two, twenty three Broadway season. And what a way to finish it off with this incredible performance. With that, another playbook for my collection and another season for the books.
